point_pr_15.label: Model-point precipitation · +1.5°C
point_pr_15.period: 20-year climate window at GMT +1.5°C; not a calendar year
point_pr_15.source: Supplied climate_points.csv; arithmetic mean of finite model-point values strictly within each prepared census tract
point_pr_15.note: Sparse point coverage: tracts containing no model point retain missing data. This differs from the separately supplied tract precipitation layer; no nearest-point substitution or interpolation is performed.

grid_sf_median.label: Single-family grid concentration · 2020
grid_sf_median.source: Supplied full-count housing_grid.geojson; median of finite whole-cell counts for cells intersecting each prepared tract
grid_sf_median.note: Cells are not clipped or area-weighted and may be shared by neighboring tracts. This is a concentration screen, not a tract housing total or a newly estimated density. A tract without an intersecting source cell retains missing data.

housing_total_records.label: Housing-stock records · combined tract count
housing_total_records.source: Sum of supplied tract attributes n_single_f and n_multi_fa
housing_total_records.note: For combination screening the point-location family uses the supplied tract record counts, not counts from the sampled static point display. Records are not independently verified dwelling-unit totals.

parcel_current_lu_mode.label: Most common changed-parcel land use · 2020
parcel_current_lu_mode.source: Mode of supplied Label_Current_Land_Use among changing parcels assigned by representative point to each prepared tract
parcel_current_lu_mode.note: A categorical condition, not a high/low ranking. Dominance is by parcel count, not land area or housing units; ties are broken alphabetically and flagged in support data. No assigned changed parcel means missing coverage, not Unknown land use. This does not describe all land in the tract.

parcel_future_lu_mode.label: Most common changed-parcel land use · 2050
parcel_future_lu_mode.source: Mode of supplied Label_Land_Use_2050 among changing parcels assigned by representative point to each prepared tract
parcel_future_lu_mode.note: A categorical condition, not a high/low ranking. Dominance is by parcel count, not land area or housing units; ties are broken alphabetically and flagged in support data. No assigned changed parcel means missing coverage, not Unknown land use. This does not describe all land in the tract.

layer_mapping.hotspot: hotspot_combo (fixed category, reconstructed by the original builder)
layer_mapping.pr_kriging: Corresponding supplied pr_15 / pr_20 / pr_25 / pr_30 tract screen; no raster-pixel extraction
layer_mapping.housing_points: n_single_f / n_multi_fa / housing_total_records (full supplied tract counts)

methods.geometry: Prepared web geometries in EPSG:3857; original analytical files are unchanged.
methods.points: Strict within assignment; at a multiple match choose the smallest GEOID deterministically and report the ambiguity. Unassigned points remain unassigned.
methods.grid: Median finite source-cell count over whole intersecting grid cells; no area weighting or cell-to-tract total allocation.
methods.land_use: Dominant supplied land-use category by changed-parcel count; alphabetical tie-breaking. Categories have no numeric ordering and require an explicit category condition.
methods.missing: No climate point, no grid cell, or no assigned changed parcel for land use produces null, not zero.
methods.kriging: The interpolated surface is a display representation. Combination screening uses the corresponding supplied tract precipitation values, not sampled raster pixels.
methods.housing_points: Use the supplied full tract record counts for combination screening, not counts of sampled point markers.
